title: Metric half TT: bike 56 km
description: METRIC HALF IRONMAN TIME TRIAL (solo, not a race): swim 1.2 km, then bike 56 km, then run 13.1 km back to back, timing the transitions. These are the 70.3 distances in miles used as km. Purpose: measure current pace and project Durban 70.3. Estimated total about 5:40 (swim ~48 min, T1 ~5, bike ~2:48, T2 ~5, run ~1:54). Mostly Z2; Z3 only late in the run. Max HR 205. LEG 2 BIKE (after T1, about 5 min): 10 min easy Z1 spin-up, then steady Z2 (cycling HR runs ~5-10 bpm below running); no Z3 surges on hills. About 20 km/h, so ~2:48. Practise 70.3 fuelling: about 60 g carbs and 500-750 ml fluid per hour, with a gel or bar every 30-40 min. Last 10 min easy to prepare the legs for the run. Record this leg on your watch as its own activity, or use a Multisport/Triathlon profile so each leg and both transitions are split automatically. Note your T1 and T2 times (from leaving the water to riding off, and from racking the bike to running off) so the Monday report can work out each leg's pace.

title: Metric half TT: run 13.1 km
description: METRIC HALF IRONMAN TIME TRIAL (solo, not a race): swim 1.2 km, then bike 56 km, then run 13.1 km back to back, timing the transitions. These are the 70.3 distances in miles used as km. Purpose: measure current pace and project Durban 70.3. Estimated total about 5:40 (swim ~48 min, T1 ~5, bike ~2:48, T2 ~5, run ~1:54). Mostly Z2; Z3 only late in the run. Max HR 205. LEG 3 RUN (after T2, about 5 min): the first 10 min are easy Z1 while your legs adjust, then steady Z2 with run-walk allowed. Z3 is allowed for the last ~15 min (about the last 2 km) if you feel good. Conservative target ~8:40/km off the bike, so ~1:54. Water every 15-20 min, and a gel at about 40 and 80 min. Stop if any pain at the hernia-repair site. Weigh naked straight after for the sweat test. Record this leg on your watch as its own activity, or use a Multisport/Triathlon profile so each leg and both transitions are split automatically. Note your T1 and T2 times (from leaving the water to riding off, and from racking the bike to running off) so the Monday report can work out each leg's pace. Distance-based steps: after the 10 min easy start, AutoZone counts 10.1 km Z2 then the final 3 km Z3 (13.1 km of steps). The 10 min start is on top of that, so allow about 2:03 for the leg.

title: Metric half TT: swim 1.2 km
